headline: Micron shares surge as outlook beats estimates - Taipei Times
summary: Micron Technology shares surged in premarket trading after its quarterly sales forecast beat Wall Street estimates, signalling continued strength in AI-driven memory demand. The company expects fiscal revenue of about US$50 billion.
why: Micron is a major US maker of memory chips used in AI servers and PCs, so its outlook is read as a gauge of demand across the semiconductor supply chain.

impacts.name: Micron Technology
impacts.why: The company's sharply higher sales forecast directly lifted its share price in premarket trading.
